ranked_facts.concept_key: CT findings of sinus expansion without bone destruction
ranked_facts.why: The strongest rival, B2.1 (Sarcoidosis), cannot explain the CT findings of sinus expansion without bone destruction, which is more characteristic of Pott's Puffy Tumor with Sinocutaneous Fistula Secondary to Chronic Sinusitis (B1.3).

ranked_facts.concept_key: MRI findings of high signal on T2-weighted image and ring enhancement in the right frontal sinus
ranked_facts.why: The strongest rival, B4.1 (Bacterial Infectious Disease), cannot explain the MRI findings of high signal on T2-weighted image and ring enhancement in the right frontal sinus, which is more characteristic of Chronic Frontal Sinusitis with Cutaneous Fistula (B1.1).
